tools.name: ask_user
tools.description: Ask the user a question and wait for the answer. Use it only when you cannot continue without their decision; it waits as long as needed, hours or days. Offer choices when there are natural options; the user can also type a free-text answer unless you set allow_text to false. The result is {"choice": ..., "text": ...}, or {"timeout": true} if timeout_seconds passed without an answer.

tools.name: memory_delete
tools.description: Delete one of your memory entries by name, for example when the user asks you to forget something.

tools.name: memory_read
tools.description: Read the full body of one of your memory entries by name (see the memory index).

tools.name: memory_write
tools.description: Save a long-term memory for this user (new, or overwrite the entry with the same name). name: [a-z0-9-]; type: user, feedback, project, reference; description: one line shown in the index; content: Markdown body.

tools.name: read_attachment
tools.description: Read a file the user attached, by its read-only path (/attachments/sha256-...). Images are shown to you. Text is cut at 2000 lines or 50 KB, whichever comes first; read in parts with offset and limit.

tools.name: todo_write
tools.description: Record and update a structured task list for the current work. Send the ENTIRE list every call: it REPLACES the previous list (there are no partial updates, no per-item edits). Use it to plan multi-step work and show progress: add one todo per concrete step before you start. Keep exactly one todo in_progress while work remains. Mark a todo completed the moment it is done (do not batch completions). Skip the list for trivial single-step tasks. Statuses: pending (not started), in_progress (being worked on now), completed (finished).

description.en: Before a command runs on your computer (bash or PowerShell), shows it on the conversation page and waits: allow, allow all commands in this session, or deny. Commands run as you, without a sandbox.
description.zh: 在你的电脑上跑命令（bash 或 PowerShell）之前，先在对话页上给你看这条命令并等你决定：允许、这个会话都允许，或者拒绝。命令以你的身份运行，没有沙箱。
description.ja: コンピューターでコマンド（bash または PowerShell）を実行する前に、会話ページにそのコマンドを表示して判断を待ちます。許可、このセッションでは常に許可、拒否から選べます。コマンドはあなたとして実行され、サンドボックスはありません。
